name: Deschutes National Forest
policyReason: Over 95% of trails are open to dogs off leash in summer.
summary: Over 95% of trails are open to dogs off leash in summer.

excerpts.quote: Over 95% of the Deschutes National Forest trails are open to dogs off-leash in the summer and there are 1,200 miles of summer trails on the forest.
In winter, dogs are allowed off-leash on 99% of national forest lands managed by the Deschutes National Forest.

dogRules.text: No dogs in the Bend Municipal Watershed.
Leash on Three Sisters Wilderness trails (Green Lakes, Moraine Lakes, South Sister and others) in summer.
Leash on part of the Deschutes River Trail, May 15 to Sept 15.
